admission.justification: Realized across core/every-role.md and roles/architect.md; omitting the scope rules or interrupt_turn=true causes Coordinators to misroute retirements or fail to release finished Investigators whose reporting turn is still active.

applicability: Shared role capsule instructions in core/every-role.md and Architect role instructions in roles/architect.md (plus their synced packaged copies).
conditions: Shared every-role instructions state the Architect, Orchestrator, and Manager retirement scopes within the shared digest budget.

Architect instructions direct retiring a finished Investigator with agents-remember-task retire_child naming agent_id and role="investigator" and supplying interrupt_turn=true when its reporting turn is still active.
exclusions: Ongoing investigations whose final report has not yet been delivered.

evidence: W2 expanded evidence E8, including the active reporting-turn and ongoing cases and measured capsule ceilings.

statement: The shared role instructions describe retirement scope, and the Architect supplies explicit interruption permission when the turn that delivered a finished Investigator report is still active.
title: Role instructions state retirement scope and active-turn Investigator release
